preconditions.description: The number of people on the network excluding Bob is between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each person's number of friends is between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The possible values of friends Bob can have are sorted in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(f, int) for f in possible_friends)
postconditions.description: Each possible value of friends Bob can have is an integer.

postconditions.expression: possible_friends == [-1] or all(0 <= f <= n for f in possible_friends)
postconditions.description: Each possible value of friends Bob can have is between 0 and n, or the list contains only -1 if no solution exists.
